name: Matchmaking Inc.
source:
A young single man returns to his hometown and takes over the family's matchmaking business. Matchmaking Inc. is a modern-themed RPG designed for men that combines gameplay elements of simulation management and text adventure.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103130/]Steam[/url]]
